anonymization: 24 history columns plus 22 random columns, zero and incrementing-counter columns; one fixed random column permutation per variant
training: First five observations of empty input, same block, boundaries 24..28
model: Infer a unique directed copy chain of length 24 from lag-one column equality across all four training transitions; ignore self-edges; do not use expected state or private permutation
evaluation: Remaining 9097 observations, never used to infer order; validate ordered history and previous 8+16-word decoder against saved evidence
negative_controls: All-zero training (ambiguous graph); duplicated history chain (two valid chains). Both must be rejected
budget: 20 minutes local work; 60 seconds process; four permutations only
limits: Trace-level experiment, not a compiled transformation or blind extraction from a Wasm binary; known aligned boundaries and representation family
